spans.s: ब्रुव a. (f. वा) (at the end of a compound) Calling oneself by a name to which he has no real title, e.g. ब्राह्मणब्रुव, क्षत्रियब्रुव.
ब्रुव a. (f. वा) (at the end of a compound) Calling oneself by a name to which he has no real title, e.g. ब्राह्मणब्रुव, क्षत्रियब्रुव.

ब्रू vt. 2U (pres. ब्रवीति, ब्रूते, also आह according to some; this root is defective and is not conjugated in the non-conjugational tenses.) (This is one of those roots which take two accusatives, e.g. माणवकं धर्मं ब्रूते) 1. To speak, to say, to tell, प्रियं च नानृतं ब्रूयादेष धर्मः सनातनः M.iv.138, ii.216, R.i.86; 2. to speak about any person or thing, (with प्रति or अधिकृत्य), अहं तु तामेवाश्रमललामभूतां शकुंतलामधिकृत्य ब्रवीमि Sak.ii.; 3. to publish, to proclaim; 4. to call, to name, तामिंद्रवज्रां ब्रुवते कवींद्राः Sr.
.With प्रति-, to speak in reply, to answer, प्रत्यब्रवीव्वैनमिषुप्रयोगे तत्पूर्वभंगे वितथप्रयत्नः R.ii.42.
